```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (14.5, 12, 16),         # NMOS CS gm/Id; sets Vov at Vgs=0.75 V and gm1 for GBW
    "L1":    (0.5, 0.15, 1.0),       # NMOS CS length
    "gmid2": (9.5, 8, 12),           # PMOS load gm/Id; lower -> less mirror Vds sensitivity
    "L2":    (0.3, 0.25, 0.3),       # PMOS load/reference length; longer -> lower gds2, better mirror match
    "I1":    (56e-6, 52e-6, 60e-6),  # signal branch current
    "IREF":  (5e-6, 4e-6, 6e-6),     # PMOS reference current (pb diode)
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    VDD = 1.8
    cl = spec.get("cl", 5e-13)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)   # testbench reference current drives ibias
    I1, IREF = p["I1"], p["IREF"]

    # Signal path: NMOS common-source M1 with PMOS current-source load M2
    op1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1, vds=0.6)
    op2 = lut.size("p", p["gmid2"], p["L2"], I1, vds=0.9)

    # Bias: PMOS diode M3 carries IREF; M2 mirrors it (same gm/Id, L, and Vds sizing point)
    opr = lut.size("p", p["gmid2"], p["L2"], IREF, vds=0.9)

    # NMOS diode M0 at ibias carries the testbench iref; M4 sinks IREF (same gm/Id and L)
    op0 = lut.size("n", 10, 1.0, iref, vds=0.6)
    op4 = lut.size("n", 10, 1.0, IREF, vds=0.6)

    n = Netlist("vin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("M1", "vout", "vin", "vss", "vss", op1)     # signal NMOS CS
    n.dev("M2", "vout", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", op2)      # PMOS current-source load
    n.dev("M3", "pb", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", opr)        # PMOS diode, sets pb
    n.dev("M4", "pb", "ibias", "vss", "vss", op4)     # NMOS sink: pulls IREF from pb
    n.dev("M0", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", op0)  # NMOS diode at ibias

    # Analytic predictions
    gm1, gds1 = op1.gm, op1.gds
    gds2 = op2.gds
    gain = gm1 / (gds1 + gds2)
    f3db = (gds1 + gds2) / (2 * PI * cl)
    gbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * cl)
    power = VDD * (I1 + iref + IREF)
    swing = (VDD - op2.vdsat) - op1.vdsat

    return n, {
        "gain_db": db(gain),
        "f3dB": f3db,
        "gbw": gbw,
        "power": power,
        "vout_dc": 0.9,
        "swing": swing,
    }
```
